comment: The best. The type of prof that makes you want to work hard. Review your practice answers with her!

My issues lie primarily with the way BA was taught. There was an overabundance of homework, including readings, participation quizzes, and case studies. Case studies were complex (take ~ 4-6 hours). There weren't model answers and class discussions were surface-level.

Listen, you had her for Civ Pro and she was amazing, I get it. IDK what happened but her BA class sucks. Multiple case studies, a homework assignment before every class, and a 2 part final exam that takes 8-10 hours in total. Not only was most of this work unnecessary and unhelpful, it was blatantly disrespectful to assign. Take Epstein instead.
